chat.voice_unavailable_body:
Voice input does not work in Expo Go. Build Recall once on your Mac, then open that app:

cd apps/mobile && pnpm expo run:android   # or run:ios
delete.message: You'll lose everything Recall keeps for you: every chat, memory, reminder, uploaded file and setting. Deleting doesn't cancel a subscription; cancel it in the App Store or Google Play first. This can't be undone.

login.error_android_google: Google Sign-In on Android needs an OAuth client in Google Cloud with package com.recall.app and your debug SHA-1. Run: ./scripts/android-debug-sha1.sh
login.error_bundle: The dev build lost connection to Metro. Keep `pnpm expo start` running, reload the app (⌘R in the simulator), then try again — or tap Continue as bini.
login.error_native_module:
Google Sign-In native code is missing. Rebuild the app:

cd apps/mobile && pnpm expo run:ios
login.error_not_configured: Google OAuth is not configured. Add EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID and EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID to apps/mobile/.env, rebuild, or use Dev Login (set EXPO_PUBLIC_DEV_AUTH_ENABLED=true and DEV_AUTH_ENABLED=true on the API).
login.google_unavailable_body:
Google Sign-In does not work in Expo Go. Build Recall once on your Mac, then open that app instead:

cd apps/mobile
pnpm expo run:ios

onboarding.chat_body: A hard question. A language. Homework. Same conversation.
onboarding.consent_chats_body: Your messages, recent chat history, relevant saved memory and profile details go to AI model providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen and Z.ai, through OpenRouter.
onboarding.consent_failed: Couldn't save your answer. Try again.
onboarding.consent_files_body: Photos and files you attach, and the text read from them, go to the same AI providers through OpenRouter.
onboarding.consent_footer: Each service handles this data under its own privacy terms. The privacy policy lists every service, what Recall keeps and how to delete it.
onboarding.consent_intro: Recall answers you with help from outside AI and search services. This is what they receive. Nothing goes to them until you agree.
onboarding.consent_location_body: Your city, and for nearby questions your exact position, is used in replies and searches.
onboarding.consent_location_title: Location, only if you turn it on
onboarding.consent_math_body: Photos of math problems you scan or send to be solved are also read by Mathpix.
onboarding.consent_search_body: Searches and photo lookups send search words based on your message to Tavily, or to public search engines as a backup. You can turn web search off in Settings.
onboarding.consent_voice_body: Voice input, read aloud and live talk send your voice and the text being read to OpenAI.
onboarding.remember_body: Tomorrow it still knows what you're working on.
onboarding.subtitle: Your AI. It doesn't start over.
